# Monkey-patch CabinClass to accept all cabin types in the DB
from typing import Literal, Optional
dm.CabinClass = Literal["business", "economy", "basic_economy", "premium_economy", "first"]

# Patch SeatPrices and AvailableSeats to use the expanded CabinClass
from typing import Annotated
from pydantic import Field
dm.SeatPrices = Annotated[
    dict[dm.CabinClass, int], Field(description="Prices for different cabin classes")
]
dm.AvailableSeats = Annotated[
    dict[dm.CabinClass, int],
    Field(description="Available seats for different cabin classes"),
]

# Patch FlightDateStatusAvailable to accept "active" status too
original_available = dm.FlightDateStatusAvailable
class PatchedFlightDateStatusAvailable(dm.BaseModel):
    status: Literal["available", "active"] = Field(description="Indicates flight is available for booking")
    available_seats: dm.AvailableSeats = Field(description="Available seats by class")
    prices: dm.SeatPrices = Field(description="Current prices by class")
dm.FlightDateStatusAvailable = PatchedFlightDateStatusAvailable

# Patch Flight to accept Optional scheduled times
class PatchedFlight(dm.FlightBase):
    scheduled_departure_time_est: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Scheduled departure time in EST"
    )
    scheduled_arrival_time_est: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Scheduled arrival time in EST"
    )
    dates: dict[str, dm.FlightDateStatus] = Field(
        description="Flight status by date (YYYY-MM-DD)"
    )
dm.Flight = PatchedFlight

# Rebuild FlightDateStatus union with patched class
from typing import Union
dm.FlightDateStatus = Union[
    PatchedFlightDateStatusAvailable,
    dm.FlightDateStatusLanded,
    dm.FlightDateStatusCancelled,
    dm.FlightDateStatusDelayed,
    dm.FlightDataStatusFlying,
    dm.FlightDataStatusOnTime,
]
